section.content: The utility model belongs to the technical field of gene detection, and discloses a biological gene detection device, which comprises a box body with a box door, wherein a controller is fixedly arranged on the right side of the box body, the top of the box body is provided with an opening, a pipettor support is arranged at the opening, a plurality of through holes are arranged on the pipettor support, a sliding cover is arranged on each through hole and is used for placing the pipettor, a plurality of gene detectors corresponding to the through holes are arranged inside the box body, the upper surface of each gene detector is a V-shaped concave surface, each concave surface is provided with a gene probe, a baffle is arranged around the concave surface, a temperature sensor is arranged on each baffle, a heating plate and a fan are arranged on the inner side wall of the box body, an ultraviolet disinfection lamp is arranged on the upper, the heating plate and the fan are both electrically connected with the output end of the controller. The device avoids the gene sample liquid to be detected from being polluted, and improves the accuracy of gene detection.

本实用新型属于基因检测技术领域，公开了一种生物基因检测装置，包括具有箱门的箱体，箱体的右侧固定安装有控制器，箱体的顶部开设有开口，开口处安装有移液器支座，移液器支座上设置有多个通孔，通孔上设置有滑盖，通孔用于放置移液器，箱体的内部设置有多个与通孔对应的基因检测仪，基因检测仪的上表面为V形的凹面，凹面设置有基因探针，凹面的周围设置有挡板，挡板上设置有温度传感器，箱体的内侧壁设置有加热板和风机，箱体的内部的上侧壁设置有紫外线消毒灯，温度传感器与控制器的输入端电连接，紫外线消毒灯、加热板和风机均与控制器的输出端电连接。本装置避免待测的基因样液受到污染，提高了基因检测的准确性。

Biological gene detection deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field specifically is a biological gene detection device.

Background

The gene detection is a technique for detecting DNA by blood, other body fluids or cells, and is a method for taking peripheral venous blood or other tissue cells of a detected person, amplifying the gene information, detecting DNA molecular information in the cells of the detected person by a specific device, and analyzing whether the gene type, the gene defect and the expression function contained in the DNA molecular information are normal or not, so that people can know the gene information of themselves, and the etiology is determined or the risk of a certain disease of the body is predicted.

The gene amplification area and the gene detection area of the gene detection laboratory are separated at intervals, so that cross contamination is prevented, sample liquid subjected to PCR amplification treatment is transferred to the detection area through a liquid transfer device, is injected into a corresponding test tube, is placed into a gene detector or is conveyed into the gene detector through a pipeline for inspection and analysis, and in the transfer detection process, the gene sample liquid is easily polluted by an internal environment or experimental appliances, so that the accuracy of gene detection is influenced.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims at providing a biological gene detection device, solve among the prior art in the transfer testing process, the gene appearance liquid receives the pollution easily, influences the problem of gene detection accuracy.

The utility model provides a basic scheme that: a biological gene detection device comprises a box body with a box door, a controller is fixedly arranged on the right side of the box body, the top of the box body is provided with an opening, a pipettor support is arranged at the opening, a plurality of through holes are arranged on the pipettor support, a sliding cover is arranged on each through hole, the through holes are used for placing pipettors, a plurality of gene detectors corresponding to the through holes are arranged in the box body, the upper surface of each gene detector is a V-shaped concave surface, gene probes are arranged at the concave surfaces, a baffle is arranged around the concave surface, a temperature sensor is arranged on the baffle, a heating plate and a fan are arranged on the inner side wall of the box body, the side wall is provided with the ultraviolet ray disinfection lamp on the inside of box, temperature sensor is connected with the input electricity of controller, ultraviolet ray disinfection lamp, hot plate and fan all are connected with the output electricity of controller.

Working principle of basic scheme: the staff uses the controller to control ultraviolet ray disinfection lamp and shines the inside 30min of box to cooperate the hot plate to carry out high temperature heating sterilization, disinfect the disinfection to the box inside. After the sterilization and disinfection are finished, the fan is controlled to start air draft to assist in cooling, the fan is controlled to run for a period of time and is closed, after the interior of the box body is cooled to a specified temperature, the sliding cover of the through hole is slid open, the pipettor is inserted into the through hole,the gene sample liquid is extruded and falls onto the gene probe of the gene detector below, and after the gene probe is completely submerged, the gene probe is fully contacted with the gene sample liquid, so that the gene detection work of the gene to be detected is completed.

The basic scheme has the advantages that: 1. the gene sample liquid of the device directly flows into the gene probe from the pipettor, and the internal environment of the box body is clean and pollution-free during exchange, so that the pollution of the gene sample liquid to be detected is avoided to the maximum extent, and the accuracy of gene detection is improved. 2. The V-shaped arrangement of the gene probe of the device can fully contact the gene probe with less gene sample liquid, thereby reducing the cost and further improving the gene detection accuracy.

Further, the method can be used for preparing a novel materialThe utility model discloses a water tank, the left side fixed mounting of box has the water tank, is equipped with the mixture of deionized water and ethanol in the water tank, and wherein ethanol content is 75%, the bottom of concave surface is connected with first pipeline, and the junction is provided with first solenoid valve, the free end of first pipeline is connected with the second pipeline, and the left end of second pipeline passes the left side wall of box and is connected with the water tank, and the junction is provided with the second solenoid valve, and third solenoid valve and suction pump are installed in proper order to the right-hand member of second pipeline, and the right-hand member of second pipeline passes the right side wall of box and is provided with the interface, first solenoid valve, second solenoid valve, third solenoid valve and suction pump all are connected with the output electricity.

Through the setting, after gene detection accomplishes, in the waste liquid treatment device is arranged to gene appearance liquid accessible pipeline, the water of water tank also enters into the concave surface through pressure, washs the completion back, washes the pipeline and discharges into waste liquid treatment device, avoids gene appearance liquid to arrange pollution detection area environment in the air in, influences next detection, and clean gene appearance piece also can be retrieved and recycled simultaneously, the cost is reduced.

Further, the method can be used for preparing a novel materialThe bottom of the concave surface inclines to the joint of the first pipeline.

Through the arrangement, the discharge efficiency of the gene sample liquid is improved.

Further, the method can be used for preparing a novel materialThe water tank is made of a transparent acrylic plate, and water is arranged on the front surface of the water tankAnd (6) bit scale marks.

Through the arrangement, the water storage capacity of the water tank can be visually and conveniently observed.

Further, the method can be used for preparing a novel materialAnd the box door is provided with an observation window.

Through the arrangement, the detection process is convenient to observe, and operation accidents are avoided.

Further, the method can be used for preparing a novel materialAnd a sealing strip is arranged at the joint of the box door and the box body and adopts a silica gel sealing strip.

Through the arrangement, the airtightness inside the box body is improved.

Detailed Description

The following is further detailed by the specific embodiments:

reference numerals in the drawings of the specification include: the device comprises a box body 1, an observation window 2, a controller 3, a pipettor support 4, a sliding cover 5, a gene detector 6, a concave surface 7, a gene probe 8, a baffle 9, a temperature sensor 10, a fan 11, a heating plate 12, an ultraviolet disinfection lamp 13, a water tank 14, a first pipeline 15, a first electromagnetic valve 16, a second pipeline 17, a second electromagnetic valve 18, a third electromagnetic valve 19 and a water suction pump 20.

Embodiments as shown in fig. 1 and 2, a biological gene testing apparatus includes a box body 1 having a box door, wherein the box door is provided with an observation window 2, which facilitates observation of a testing process and prevents operation accidents. The sealing strip is arranged at the joint of the box door and the box body 1, and the sealing strip is a silica gel sealing strip, so that the airtightness inside the box body 1 is improved. The right side of the box body 1 is fixedly provided with a controller 3, the top of the box body 1 is provided with an opening, the opening is provided with a pipettor support 4, the pipettor support 4 is provided with three through holes, the through holes are all provided with sliding covers 5, the shapes of the through holes are matched with the pipettors, three gene detectors 6 corresponding to the through holes are arranged inside the box body 1, the upper surface of each gene detector 6 is a V-shaped concave surface 7, each concave surface 7 is provided with a gene probe 8, baffle plates 9 are arranged around the concave surfaces 7, a temperature sensor 10 is arranged on the middle baffle plate 9, a heating plate 12 is arranged on the right side wall inside the box body 1, a fan 11 is arranged on the left side wall inside the box body 1, two ultraviolet disinfection lamps 13 are arranged on the upper side wall inside the box body 1, the, the heating plate 12 and the fan 11 are both electrically connected to the output of the controller 3.

A water tank 14 is fixedly arranged at the left side of the box body 1, the water tank 14 is made of a transparent acrylic plate, the front side of the water tank 14 is provided with water level scale marks, a mixture of deionized water and ethanol is filled in the water tank 14, wherein the ethanol content is 75 percent, the water level of the water tank 14 is higher than the height of the baffle 9, the bottom of the concave surface 7 is connected with a first pipeline 15, the bottom of the concave surface 7 inclines to the joint of the first pipeline 15, the joint is provided with a first electromagnetic valve 16, the free end of the first pipeline 15 is connected with a second pipeline 17, the left end of the second pipeline 17 passes through the left side wall of the tank body 1 to be connected with the water tank 14, the joint is provided with a second electromagnetic valve 18, the right end of the second pipeline 17 is sequentially provided with a third electromagnetic valve 19 and a water suction pump 20, and the right end of the second pipeline 17 passes through the right side wall of the box body 1 and is provided with a port, and the first electromagnetic valve 16, the second electromagnetic valve 18, the third electromagnetic valve 19 and the water pump 20 are all electrically connected with the output end of the controller 3.

During specific work, the worker controls the ultraviolet disinfection lamp 13 to irradiate the inside of the box body 1 for 30min by using the controller 3, and the ultraviolet disinfection lamp is matched with the heating plate 12 to perform high-temperature heating sterilization to sterilize and disinfect the inside of the box body 1. After the sterilization and disinfection are completed, the fan 11 is controlled to open air draft for auxiliary cooling, the fan 11 is operated for a period of time and is closed, after the interior of the box body 1 is cooled to a specified temperature, the sliding cover 5 of the through hole is slid open, the pipettor is inserted into the through hole, the gene sample liquid is extruded and falls onto the gene probe 8 of the gene detector 6 below, and after the gene probe 8 is dripped into the box body to be completely submerged, the gene probe 8 is fully contacted with the gene sample liquid, so that the gene detection work of the gene to be detected is completed. After the detection is finished, a worker controls the first electromagnetic valve 16, the third electromagnetic valve 19 and the water suction pump 20 to be opened through the controller 3, the gene sample liquid is discharged, after the sample liquid is discharged, the third electromagnetic valve 19 and the water suction pump 20 are closed, the second electromagnetic valve 18 is opened, water in the water tank 14 enters the groove formed by the baffle 9 and the concave surface 7 in the enclosed city through pressure, when the water in the groove is full, the second electromagnetic valve 18 is closed, after one end of cleaning time, the third electromagnetic valve 19 and the water suction pump 20 are opened, the water is discharged, and the gene probe 8 is cleaned.

The above embodiments of the present invention are only examples, and the common knowledge of the known specific structures and characteristics in the schemes is not described too much, it should be noted that, for those skilled in the art, without departing from the structure of the present invention, several modifications and improvements can be made, and these should be regarded as the protection scope of the present invention, and these will not affect the effect of the implementation of the present invention and the practicability of the patent. The scope of the claims of the present application shall be determined by the contents of the claims, and the description of the embodiments and the like in the specification shall be used to explain the contents of the claims.
